Subject: MAP Draft — Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling, Structured Outputs)

Thanks for the call this morning — really productive. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the Integration Build Plan milestone. Below is a short post-call recap and the ask for engineering owners to review and confirm estimates.

High-level target close date: 2027-02-28 (ACME PO + onboarding).

Milestones (draft)
1) SDK integration (client libraries, auth, example apps) — owner: Dev Patel
   - Deliverables: language SDKs (Python, Node), sample app, auth flow guide
2) Streaming & low-latency config (server + client) — owner: Marcus Lin
   - Deliverables: streaming API config, client streaming examples, perf SLOs
3) Tool calling & structured outputs — owner: Lauren Bishop
   - Deliverables: tool spec mapping, JSON schema examples, security checklist
4) E2E QA & performance validation — owner: Marissa Cole
   - Deliverables: test plan, perf benchmark report, canary rollout plan

Dependencies:
- Signed PO and SOW from Acme (blocking for reserved capacity)
- VPC peering / network access for staging cluster
- Sample dataset + expected throughput profile from Acme

Proposed next steps:
- Internal owners (Dev/Marcus/Lauren) please confirm owners and rough estimates by EOD Mon Jan 17.
- I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and share the link + updated file after your feedback.

Attachments: acme_map_draft_v2.xlsx, sdk_integration_spec.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: MAP Draft — Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling, Structured Outputs)

Thanks Marissa — quick engineering read and preliminary estimates below. I've attached an internal estimate outline.

Summary / Risks
- SDK integration: estimated 3 sprints (6 weeks) to produce stable Python + Node SDKs, samples, and auth flows. Major risk: Acme uses a custom tokenization pipeline that will require a short adapter; need sample corpus to validate.
- Streaming infra + client work: can be done in parallel over 2 sprints (4 weeks) once staging cluster is available. Needs network peering + SSL certs in our staging VPC.
- Tool calling + structured outputs: straightforward mapping work but will require 1 sprint of engineering + 1 sprint of QA for the schema and security review.

Phased delivery recommendation to meet 2027-02-28 target:
Phase 1 (MVP, target Feb 14): SDKs (core flows), basic streaming demo, tool-calling PoC with 2 tools
Phase 2 (Post-PO, by Mar 15): full SDK polish, expanded streaming scale tests, full tool calling and structured schema coverage

Blocked items for estimates:
- Acme to provide example requests and expected RPS/latency targets
- VPC peering details and access window for staging

Attachments: dev_estimates_acme.md, sdk_integration_sequence.png

I'll own SDK integration and can pair with Marcus on streaming.

 Dev

Subject: Re: MAP Draft — Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling, Structured Outputs)

Couple of architectural notes from the streaming/perf side:
- For low-latency streaming we should prefer websockets for full-duplex with binary framing (protobuf) or server-sent events for simpler clients. I'll prototype both on a private branch and share perf numbers.
- Tool calling: recommend we standardize on a small JSON schema map for each tool and provide a helper in SDKs to serialize/deserialize. This avoids multiple ad-hoc formats.
- Canary rollout: we should plan a canary with 1% traffic then 10% before full cutover; I can handle rollout hooks and tracing integration.

Jira references: INF-482 (streaming perf), INF-511 (tool-calling schema)

I'll link a short architecture note. I'm happy to take the streaming and rollout work; Dev and I can coordinate on the client-server handoffs.

Attachment: streaming_arch_notes.pdf (PDF)

 Marcus
